mapper.select: select user_uuid from comment_reply where id = #{replyId} and status = 1 limit 1

select cr.id, cr.root_comment_id as rootCommentId, cr.parent_reply_id as parentReplyId, cr.user_uuid as userUuid, u.nickname as nickname, cr.target_user_uuid as targetUserUuid, tu.nickname as targetNickname, cr.content, cr.created_at as createdAt from comment_reply cr left join user u on cr.user_uuid = u.uuid left join user tu on cr.target_user_uuid = tu.uuid where cr.root_comment_id = #{rootCommentId} and cr.status = 1 order by cr.created_at asc, cr.id asc
